newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares mixed, dealers divided.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares mixed, dealers divided.

text.p: Latvian shares were mixed on Monday in higher turnover and dealers were divided over what direction the struggling market would take.
Overall market volume was 63,000 lats compared to 40,000 lats on Friday and the Rietumu index inched up 0.36 percent to 181.89.
One broker said that low prices seemed to be luring investors back to the market, which has been sluggish in recent weeks.
But other dealers say that the market will not see sustained growth until it adds really big and attractive companies.
"There just is not a lot of interest now," said one broker.
Three of the five official list stocks eased at the session and one held steady. Kaija Fish Cannery lost the most ground, easing 4.9 percent to 2.15 lats in trade of 300 lats.
Unibanka was the only gainer on the official list, rising to 3.26 lats from 3.31 lats in trade of 5,200 lats.
On the secondary list, Valmiera Glassfibre rose to 1.52 lats from 1.50 lats in turnover of 6,100 lats.
